blocks.html: Core samples and/or test panels shall be cut with reinforcing steel and shall be visually evaluated by the registered design professional of record for the structural design, or a registered design professional acceptable to the registered design professional of record for the structural design. The nozzleman shall not proceed with work if cores and/or sections cut show the rebar not to be encapsulated with concrete to the satisfaction of the registered design professional of record for the structural design.
